About

I am a Senior Structural BIM Engineer with more than seven years of experience delivering multidisciplinary projects across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

I specialize in BIM coordination, structural modeling, and workflow automation. My work helps project teams collaborate better, reduce coordination issues, and deliver high-quality BIM models.

  • Leading multidisciplinary BIM coordination
  • Managing ACC collaboration environments
  • Developing Dynamo and pyRevit automation tools
  • Optimizing BIM workflows
  • Delivering to ISO 19650 best practices
  • Mentoring junior BIM engineers
  • Improving model quality and coordination efficiency
